_comment: Rain (the V2 avatar generation) animated emote mapping, shared by BambiSleep, Sissy and CCP Default. Clip = Resources/rain_emotes/<clip>.webp, played by the WPF tube's SkiaSharp lane (AvatarTube/EmoteClipPlayer.cs) (animated WebP, real alpha, 384x618 = 2x the tube, 15 fps, one crop box for every clip, feet on one baseline). Pre-rendered from the locked Rain base of 2026-10-14 (repertoire revision 2 + shy repertoire). Same schema and runtime rules as avatar0_emotes: per spoken line [talk clip(s) by length] then [one reaction emote by situation], each clip played ONCE then crossfaded. Every clip starts and ends on the shared rest pose. Rain has 17 clips (the 12 of 2026-10-24 plus five reactions of 2026-10-30: joy, surprise, affection, confidence, disappointment), so avatar0's reaction names are folded onto her nearest performance: celebrate -> joy, praise and sultry -> confidence, denial -> disappointment, tender and adoring -> affection, surprised -> surprise. Trance moments (entrancing) stay on idle until a drift clip exists.

talking._comment: Three talk clips: the accepted idle (talk_a, talk_b) or listening (talk_c) body with silent speech-like mouth movement from the V13 library layered on top at twice its authored amplitude (so it reads at tube size); not phoneme lip-sync. The mouth fades in over the first 0.3 s and back to rest by 5.9 s (clip_timing.json).

expressive._comment: Giggles / 'mmm' / short non-verbal sounds play ONE of these (no mouth-flapping), held full length.

clipScale._comment: Empty: every clip shares one crop box.

layout._comment: Delta on top of the mod's avatar layout, same meaning as avatar0. Rain's one crop box keeps headroom and width for the jump's raised arms, so standing she is about 235 px of the 309 canvas (avatar0: 297 px, drawn at 0.79 = about 235). Scale 1.0 gives her avatar0's on-screen standing height; she is centred and her feet end about 2 px above the canvas bottom, like avatar0. Offsets copied from avatar0. Desk run 2026-10-24: owner wants her smaller, 0.84 on screen (the Avalonia head drew 0.75 times its 1.12 for sets above 1). WPF plays Rain as V2 on the base set, which gets no 1.12, so the scale here is 0.84 itself.
